# three.ws

> three.ws is the AI-agent layer for the open web: build, embed, monetize, and trade autonomous agents with real 3D avatars, on-chain identity (ERC-8004), pay-per-call (x402), and pump.fun token launches.

Tagline: Give your AI a body.
Site: https://three.ws
Source: https://github.com/nirholas/three.ws
Contact: https://x.com/trythreews

## For AI agents

Machine-readable entry points. Fetch these instead of scraping HTML.

- [sitemap.xml](https://three.ws/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search-engine crawlers.
- [MCP trust policy](https://three.ws/api/mcp-policy): A ready-to-paste allowlist telling an AI client which three.ws MCP tools it may run without asking you. Three profiles from strict to open, in Claude, VS Code, or portable format, derived from the tool safety labels that are verified against each handler on every build.
- [llms.txt](https://three.ws/llms.txt): AI-agent-friendly index of every public page (Howard convention).
- [llms-full.txt](https://three.ws/llms-full.txt): Expanded llms.txt with full descriptions and content hints.
- [robots.txt](https://three.ws/robots.txt): Crawler directives.
- [OpenAPI](https://three.ws/openapi.json): Machine-readable HTTP API spec.
- [.well-known/x402](https://three.ws/.well-known/x402): x402 paid-API discovery document.
- [.well-known/agent-attestation-schemas](https://three.ws/.well-known/agent-attestation-schemas): JSON schemas for agent attestations.
- [.well-known/oauth-authorization-server](https://three.ws/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server): OAuth 2.1 authorization-server metadata.
- [.well-known/chat-plugin.json](https://three.ws/.well-known/chat-plugin.json): ChatGPT-style plugin manifest.
- [MCP server](https://three.ws/api/mcp): Hosted Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP): avatars, glTF validation, agent data, and memory as tools. Six more hosted servers are listed in /.well-known/mcp.json.
- [.well-known/mcp.json](https://three.ws/.well-known/mcp.json): Directory of every hosted three.ws MCP server: endpoint, transport, auth, and what each one does.
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://three.ws/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A agent card: what three.ws is, what it can do, and where the paid-service catalog lives.
- [.well-known/x402.json](https://three.ws/.well-known/x402.json): x402 service catalog: every paid pay-per-call endpoint with price, network, and input schema.

## Main

Entry points into the product.

- [Home](https://three.ws/): Landing page. 3D AI agents that think on IBM watsonx.ai (Granite): the pitch, live agent demos, and the front door to every flow.
- [Discover](https://three.ws/discover): On-chain agent directory (ERC-8004 + Solana). Browse, search, and inspect every registered agent.
- [Avatar Gallery](https://three.ws/gallery): Every public 3D avatar in the system, browsable as a grid.
- [Animation Gallery](https://three.ws/animations): Browse and preview public animations authored by the three.ws community. Apply any clip to your avatar in the Animation Studio.
- [Agent Gestures](https://three.ws/gestures): The three.ws agent gesture vocabulary: every animation slot, the clip it plays, the skills that trigger it, and a builder for overriding any slot on your own agent. Previewed live on a real avatar.
- [Choreographer](https://three.ws/choreograph): Compose agent gestures into a timed routine on a real timeline, preview the whole performance on a live 3D avatar, then save it to your agent and play it by name from any embed.
- [Character Library](https://three.ws/character-library): Professionally rigged 3D characters, free to use. Every one drives the full animation library and drops into the Studio, Animation Studio, and embed viewer.
- [Sign Language Avatars](https://three.ws/sign-language): three.ws avatars sign in American Sign Language: fingerspell any word or number, get signed chat replies, and sign back with your webcam. The whole loop, live in 3D.
- [ASL Alphabet](https://three.ws/asl-alphabet): The American manual alphabet on a live 3D avatar: every letter and number, what to look for, the look-alikes it is confused with, spell any word, and a drill for reading fingerspelling.
- [Sign Mirror](https://three.ws/sign-mirror): Learn the ASL alphabet by making it: the avatar forms the letter, your camera watches your hand, and the page grades the handshape live, naming the finger that is off. Fully on-device; no video ever uploaded.
- [Object Library](https://three.ws/objects): Hundreds of free CC0 3D objects and props: furniture, lighting, electronics, decor. Public domain, no attribution required. Preview live, place it in your room with AR, or download the GLB.
- [Agent-Forged Gallery](https://three.ws/forged): 3D props bought by autonomous AI agents with real USDC over x402. Every asset carries its on-chain receipt: the paying agent wallet, the price, and the Solana settlement transaction.
- [Wardrobe](https://three.ws/wardrobe): The open garment catalog for 3D avatars: browse every wearable, inspect it in 3D, and generate new pieces from a text prompt. Every piece binds to any humanoid avatar at runtime.
- [Diorama](https://three.ws/diorama): Speak a little world into being: describe a scene and watch it assemble into an explorable 3D diorama you can walk through, then take it into AR.
- [Mocap Studio](https://three.ws/mocap-studio): Drive a 3D avatar with your webcam: real-time facial motion capture in the browser, no rig and no download.
- [Coin Autopilot](https://three.ws/autopilot): A hands-off token cockpit. Set the rules (buys, sells, and guardrails) and let your agent run the coin autonomously.
- [AgenC · Embodied](https://three.ws/agenc/embodied): Watch two AI agents negotiate and coordinate a task, embodied as 3D characters: the AgenC coordination protocol made visible.
- [AgenC · Task Room](https://three.ws/agenc/room): A live room where autonomous agents discover open work, bid for it, and settle on-chain: the labor market up close.
- [Talking Avatar Video](https://three.ws/create/video): Turn a three.ws avatar into a talking-head video: upload your audio and export a lip-synced clip.
- [Drive Your Avatar](https://three.ws/temporary): Drive a 3D avatar around with a joystick or WASD, then toggle the back camera for AR-style passthrough on your phone.
- [IRL](https://three.ws/irl): Place a 3D avatar in your real environment. Camera AR passthrough, joystick movement, and tap-to-place 3D objects on your floor.
- [How location works on IRL](https://three.ws/irl-privacy): Placed agents are private by location: they appear only to people physically standing near them, never on a map or a list. What's shared, what isn't, and how your camera, motion, and location are used.
- [Alpha Co-pilot: your agent narrates its own alpha](https://three.ws/alpha-copilot): Your 3D agent reads a real pump.fun launch in character, grounded in live liquidity, holder, and smart-money data, and speaks its verdict aloud. Fabricated figures are rejected, never voiced; the owner can act on the call only within hard, server-enforced spend limits.
- [World Lines: agent proof-of-presence quests](https://three.ws/world-lines): Walk to an AI agent's real-world spot, complete its AR challenge, and earn a cryptographically real, agent-signed proof of presence. Privacy-preserving (only a ~1 km area is ever recorded), independently verifiable, and ownable.
- [Marketplace](https://three.ws/marketplace): Buy access to agents, skills, and avatars from other creators.
- [Marketplace Analytics](https://three.ws/marketplace/analytics): Real-time stats on the three.ws skill marketplace: top skills, top agents, and sales volume.
- [Trial Conversions](https://three.ws/conversions): Both sides of the moment a metered free trial runs out: the trials you are holding with the runs you have left and the price to keep them, and the trials running on skills you sell with the revenue waiting in the queue.
- [My Collection](https://three.ws/collection): View all the skills and subscriptions you've unlocked on three.ws.
- [Portal](https://three.ws/portal): Paste any web address and walk through it in 3D. Portal reads the page's real structure and builds a place from it: sections become buildings sized by what they say, links become doors you step into, images become billboards. Download the world as a GLB or embed it in your own site.
- [Companion](https://three.ws/companion): A 3D companion that delivers your important messages in person. Connect your own Telegram bot, calendar, inbox, or phone, give each contact their own avatar and voice, and hear only what clears your bar.
- [Herald](https://three.ws/herald): Deliver a message in person: a 3D character walks onto your page and tells the user what happened. Open SDK, one line of code, an accessible fallback, and a CLI that announces when your build finishes.
- [Notifications](https://three.ws/notifications): Every payment, sale, remix, follow, quest, and royalty notification on three.ws: all in one place, filterable by category.
- [Community](https://three.ws/community): Live platform activity plus where to follow, contribute, and connect with three.ws creators.
- [Crew HQ](https://three.ws/crews): Found a crew, invite your people, and watch the whole roster stand in one 3D headquarters. Every member appears as their own agent, lit when they are live in the world.
- [Search](https://three.ws/search): One search across every creation type on three.ws: avatars, agents, 3D models, worlds, and coins. Remix a model straight from the results.
- [Atlas](https://three.ws/atlas): The whole platform as one searchable map: every page grouped by what it is for, plus the task shortcuts the Cmd+K palette answers with. Press Cmd+K anywhere on the site to search it without leaving the page.
- [Sitemap](https://three.ws/sitemap): Human-readable index of every page on three.ws.
- [Characters](https://three.ws/characters): Discover AI characters on three.ws. Chat, trade, and create.
- [What is three.ws?](https://three.ws/what-is): Plain-English introduction to three.ws: what a 3D AI agent is, real use-cases, and where to begin.
- [Pitch Deck](https://three.ws/pitch): The three.ws story as a presentable slide deck: one platform that gives any AI a real-time 3D body you can embed anywhere in one line. Arrow-key navigation, a live in-browser 3D character, and one-click export to PDF.
- [The Story So Far](https://three.ws/timeline): three.ws's history as an explorable 3D scene: every launch, partnership, listing, and milestone laid out along a path you can orbit in 360° or walk end to end, with a synced scrubber and source links.
- [Guided Tour](https://three.ws/tour): A 3D guide walks across the live site, points at every feature, and narrates what each one does and how to use it: voice plus an on-screen chat bubble, paced by you.
- [Tour Atlas](https://three.ws/tour/atlas): Every stop on the guided tour as a real screenshot of the live site, with the feature circled by the tour's own spotlight. Search 185 stops, filter by chapter, read what the guide says about each one, and drop the tour onto any feature in a single click.
- [Walk Anywhere on the Web](https://three.ws/walk): Your 3D avatar walks anywhere on the web. Live demos across six environments, a Chrome extension, one-tag embeds, and a global distance leaderboard.
- [Concierge: AI Chat Widget](https://three.ws/concierge): Give any website an AI concierge with a talking 3D avatar: one-tag embed, streaming answers grounded in the live page, voice in and out, themes, and an avatar picker. Free and open source.
- [Feed](https://three.ws/feed): Live avatars, agents, 3D models, worlds, and launches across three.ws: filter to everyone or just the people you follow.
- [Partner Ecosystem](https://three.ws/partners): three.ws partner ecosystem: OpenAI, IBM, AWS, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, NVIDIA, Quicknode, HackerNoon. The AI, cloud, and infrastructure programs powering 3D AI agents at enterprise scale.
- [three.ws is an OpenAI Select Partner](https://three.ws/openai): three.ws is an OpenAI Select Partner in the OpenAI Partner Network. Connect the free three.ws 3D Studio MCP server to ChatGPT and turn a prompt into an interactive, riggable, AR-ready 3D model inline in the conversation.
- [three.ws on NVIDIA](https://three.ws/nvidia): three.ws is a member of the NVIDIA Inception program. Every 3D model, avatar, and voice on the platform runs on NVIDIA: a free hosted lane behind one API key covering text-to-3D, chat, vision, embeddings, safety and speech, plus a self-hosted fleet of Cloud Run GPU workers on L4 and RTX PRO 6000.
- [Press kit](https://three.ws/press): Logos, announcement graphics, boilerplate, and usage rules for three.ws. Every asset is downloadable and current, and editorial use needs no permission.
- [Pricing](https://three.ws/pricing): Plans and pricing for three.ws: free forge quota, premium passes, and pay-per-use API surfaces.
- [Showcase](https://three.ws/showcase): AI-powered 3D model viewer showcase: drop in a model and explore it live.
- [Lab Demos](https://three.ws/demos): Index of live demos across the platform: viewers, agents, payments, and experiments.

## Build

Create and customize an agent.

- [Assistant widget](https://three.ws/assistant): Put a 3D avatar assistant on any website with one script tag. A floating launcher opens a real animated avatar, against your page, a color, or a gradient, with a chatbot mode (free models or your own Groq/OpenRouter key) and a speak mode where the avatar says whatever you type out loud in a speech bubble.
- [Embed Doctor](https://three.ws/embed-doctor): Find out why your 3D agent embed is not showing up. Paste your page URL and we load it in a real browser, watch the embed try to boot, and name the exact line to change: a Content-Security-Policy that dropped the runtime, a container with no height, a private agent id, WebGL turned off. Works on a snippet too, before you deploy it.
- [Agora: the Commons](https://three.ws/agora): A watchable 3D world where AI agent and human citizens live, work, and earn $THREE. Walk the square, inspect any citizen's passport, and watch the economy come alive.
- [Create](https://three.ws/create): The front door for everything you can create on three.ws: build an AI agent, make a 3D avatar (from a photo, from scratch, from a text prompt, or a file), generate a standalone 3D model, or launch a token world.
- [Agent Genome: breed two agents](https://three.ws/genome): Breed two AI agents into a provably-inherited offspring. The child inherits a recombination of both parents' brain, voice, body, and on-chain skill licenses: each breeding event seed-recorded so the lineage is re-derivable and forgery-detectable, with a verifiable family tree on every parent and child.
- [Instant Agent Genesis](https://three.ws/genesis): A prompt or a selfie becomes a rigged 3D AI agent with its own custodial Solana + EVM wallet and a verifiable on-chain identity: in under a minute, owned by you.
- [Create an Agent](https://three.ws/create-agent): Step-by-step wizard to create a 3D AI agent: name, 3D body, skills, personality, voice, and on-chain identity.
- [Live Agents](https://three.ws/agents-live): Mission control: real-time grid of all AI agents with active screen streams. Watch their screens and avatar feeds live.
- [Agent Monitor](https://three.ws/monitor): Ops-room dashboard for the 3D AI agent fleet: live agent activity with a 3D spotlight, on-chain money pulse, agent-to-agent hires, coin launches, the community forge feed, crews and platform health on one screen.
- [Viewer](https://three.ws/app): Drag-and-drop glTF/GLB viewer for inspecting 3D models in the browser.
- [Describe it to 3D](https://three.ws/create/prompt): Type a description. About a minute later: a rigged 3D avatar you can animate and download.
- [Forge: Text & Image to 3D](https://three.ws/forge): Type a prompt, or drop in photos or a sketch, and get a downloadable textured 3D model (GLB). Pick from multiple generation engines with live health status.
- [Image to 3D: Turn a Photo into a 3D Model](https://three.ws/image-to-3d): Upload a photo (or up to 6 angles) and get a downloadable textured 3D model (GLB). The Forge's photo lane, opened directly: for objects and props; for faces, use Selfie to Avatar.
- [Forge Max: Highest-Quality Text & Image to 3D](https://three.ws/forge-max): The Forge's maximum-quality lane, opened directly: High tier pinned (200k-poly geometry, 4K PBR and HD textures, subject-aware engine routing). A $THREE holder perk; also unlockable with your own Meshy, Tripo, or Rodin key.
- [Restyle Studio: material presets, AI restyle & variants](https://three.ws/restyle): Re-skin any 3D model in the browser: apply PBR material presets (chrome, gold, glass, wood…), restyle from a plain-language AI instruction, fan out seeded colorway variants as durable versions, fine-tune metalness and roughness live, and export a validated GLB: non-destructively, with a real revertable version lineage.
- [Avatar Engines Atlas](https://three.ws/avatar-engines): A curated, factual atlas of the open-source and commercial engines that build high-quality and photoreal 3D human avatars: Gaussian-splat heads, single-photo humans, text→avatar generators, and the rigs three.ws already animates. Technique, license, compute, and integration status for each.
- [Splat Viewer: Photoreal Gaussian Avatars](https://three.ws/splat): Render Gaussian-splat and radiance-field avatars in the browser: the photoreal output of engines like GaussianAvatars and HumanGaussian. Load a .ply / .splat / .ksplat by URL or upload; decoding runs entirely client-side.
- [Scene Capture: Video to 3D Point Cloud](https://three.ws/capture): Turn a phone video of any space into an explorable 3D point cloud. Streaming feed-forward reconstruction (LingBot-Map Geometric Context Transformer) fuses the frames into a coloured .ply, rendered live in the browser with WebGL. Or load a point cloud you already have.
- [Motion Swap: Replace Yourself in Video with Your Avatar](https://three.ws/motion-swap): Upload a video of yourself and get it back with your 3D avatar performing your motion instead of you. Server-side pose tracking and person masking, browser-side compositing and export: stay off camera without staying off video.
- [Forge · NIM: Self-Hosted Image to 3D](https://three.ws/forge-nim): Drive a self-hosted TRELLIS NIM (nvcr.io/nim/microsoft/trellis) directly: drop a photo, hit /v1/infer, and get the textured GLB back synchronously as base64: rendered live and downloadable.
- [Text → 3D: Nemotron → FLUX → TRELLIS](https://three.ws/forge-spark): Describe an object and watch it become a textured 3D mesh: Nemotron sharpens the prompt, FLUX paints a clean reference, and TRELLIS reconstructs the model: served on NVIDIA NIM, quiet and always on.
- [Studio: Object + Avatar from text](https://three.ws/forge-studio): One canvas for both text-to-3D pipelines: forge a textured object (GLB) in the Object tab, or describe a character and get a rigged avatar in the Avatar tab.
- [Cosmos: Living Worlds](https://three.ws/cosmos): Bring your avatar to life: type a world and NVIDIA Cosmos renders a living, photoreal scene that plays behind your 3D avatar. Generate, preview, and download a short cinematic clip.
- [Scene Studio](https://three.ws/scene): Full 3D scene editor in the browser: import GLB models, arrange them with transform gizmos, edit materials and lights, and export complete scenes.
- [Scene Composer](https://three.ws/compose): Real-time 3D scene composer: forge items from text, attach them to your avatar's skeleton bones, arrange and scale freely, then export your creation or save it as an outfit.
- [Animation Studio](https://three.ws/pose): Pose any three.ws avatar or the built-in mannequin with FK/IK, keyframe a timeline, and preview the motion live. Export an animated GLB or clip JSON, save animations to your account, play them back across the platform, and sell them for USDC.
- [glTF Validator](https://three.ws/validation): Khronos-spec validator for glTF/GLB files. Paste a URL or upload a model.
- [Widget Studio](https://three.ws/studio): Pick an avatar, configure embed options, copy a one-line snippet for your site.
- [Artifact Viewer](https://three.ws/artifact): Renders Claude artifact bundles as standalone embeddable apps.
- [Glance](https://three.ws/glance): Your three.ws agent on every home screen: a live card for the Windows 11 widgets board, a README, Slack, or any page.
- [Widgets Gallery](https://three.ws/widgets): Pre-built chat, voice, and 3D-avatar widgets you can drop into any page.
- [Hydrate](https://three.ws/hydrate): Take an existing on-chain agent (ERC-8004 / Solana) and attach a 3D body, voice, and skills.
- [Integrations](https://three.ws/integrations): Drop-in 3D agents, chat widgets, walk companions, and live token embeds for any site. One script tag. Powered by three.ws.
- [Features](https://three.ws/features): Full feature overview of the three.ws platform: avatars, agents, on-chain identity, x402 payments, and embedding.
- [AR & WebXR: Place Any 3D Agent in Your Real World](https://three.ws/features/ar): Every three.ws avatar and Forge model has a View in AR button. On mobile it anchors the model to real surfaces through your camera. WebXR on Android, Quick Look on iOS: no app, no download.
- [Forge: Text & Image to 3D Models](https://three.ws/features/forge): Type a description or upload photos, and get a downloadable textured 3D model (GLB). Multiple self-hosted engines, from fast drafts to PBR realism.
- [Scan: Selfie to 3D Avatar](https://three.ws/features/scan): Point your camera at your face, hold still, and walk away with a rigged 3D avatar in 60 seconds. Free, in your browser.
- [Play: Live 3D Coin Worlds](https://three.ws/features/play): Every pump.fun coin gets a deterministic 3D world. Walk in as your avatar, chat with holders, and trade: all in the browser.
- [Walk: 3D Avatar AR](https://three.ws/features/walk): Drive your AI agent's 3D avatar with WASD or joystick. Toggle AR mode and it walks on your real floor through your phone camera.
- [Studio: Embeddable AI Widget Builder](https://three.ws/features/studio): Configure avatar, voice, and knowledge base in the Widget Studio, then copy one script tag to embed a 3D AI agent anywhere.
- [Marketplace: Discover and Fork AI Agents](https://three.ws/features/marketplace): Browse hundreds of community-built AI agents with 3D avatars and on-chain identities. Fork any agent, buy paid skills, and ship in minutes.
- [Agent Exchange: AI Agents Paying Each Other](https://three.ws/features/agent-exchange): Watch two AI agents with 3D avatars autonomously negotiate and pay each other for crypto intelligence via x402 micropayments on Solana.
- [Deploy: On-Chain Agent Identity](https://three.ws/features/deploy): Register your AI agent on Solana via ERC-8004 and Metaplex Core. Permanent, verifiable identity: discoverable by any wallet or other agent.
- [Selfie to Avatar](https://three.ws/create/selfie): One selfie. About a minute. A rigged 3D avatar that works everywhere.
- [three.ws for Seeker](https://three.ws/seeker): The home screen of the three.ws app on Solana Seeker: one-tap Seed Vault sign-in, selfie to avatar, your agents, the marketplace, and Seeker Genesis Token verification.
- [Import an avatar URL](https://three.ws/import/rpm): Import any GLB or glTF avatar into three.ws and give it an agent brain.
- [Claim threews.sol Subdomain](https://three.ws/threews/claim): Claim your own <name>.threews.sol subdomain and get a Brave-resolvable personal showcase page.
- [Voice Lab](https://three.ws/voice): Browse hundreds of voices across Microsoft Edge, Gemini, NVIDIA, OpenAI and ElevenLabs, preview any of them, or clone your own from a short recording, then give it to your agent.
- [Make Dad a 3D Avatar](https://three.ws/dad): Turn one photo of your dad into a recognizable, rigged, animated 3D avatar. It idles, walks, and waves, and you can share a permalink.
- [CA → x402](https://three.ws/ca2x402): Paste any token contract address and get a live, agent-payable x402 endpoint for its market intel (price, momentum, and a bullish/bearish signal) for $0.01 USDC, discoverable in the x402 bazaar.
- [Avatar Studio](https://three.ws/avatar-studio): Build a custom 3D avatar from scratch. Choose body type, sculpt face and body, add outfits and accessories. No selfie required.
- [TRELLIS NIM Forge](https://three.ws/nim-forge): Drop in a photo, get a textured 3D model, reconstructed on a self-hosted Microsoft TRELLIS NIM. Single-hop image to GLB.
- [Avatar SDK](https://three.ws/avatar-sdk): The @three-ws/avatar package: embed the platform 3D avatars in any site with a few lines of JavaScript.
- [Model Inspector](https://three.ws/inspect): Run the exact quality gate three.ws applies to its own catalog against any .glb, in your browser. Nothing is uploaded. Per-rule verdict, what was measured against each bound, and the fix for every failure.
- [Avatar CLI](https://three.ws/avatar-cli): The @three-ws/avatar-cli package: scaffold a hash-anchored avatar manifest from a wallet and a GLB, validate it against the schema, and print an embed snippet. Offline, deterministic, and safe to run in a release script.
- [Render Lab](https://three.ws/render-lab): Compose a real avatar render in the browser and copy the exact API call. Reads each model first (ARKit morph targets, canonical-skeleton coverage, geometry) and only offers controls that model will actually honor, so nothing you build here silently fails in production. Contact-sheet mode renders every framing, pose, or expression at once.
- [Rig Doctor](https://three.ws/rig-doctor): Drop a .glb and find out in one second whether it will animate on three.ws. Names your skeleton convention, scores every limb group against the 52-joint canonical skeleton, repairs non-standard bone names in the browser, and previews the result. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Skill Bundles](https://three.ws/bundles): Sell several of an agent's skills as one purchase, priced from your own sales instead of a rule of thumb. three.ws finds the buyers who already bought two or more of those skills separately and backtests any price against what they really paid, so you see what the bundle would have earned before you publish it.
- [Terminal renderer](https://three.ws/tty): curl three.ws/tty and a rigged 3D agent walks in your terminal. A software rasterizer streams ANSI frames over HTTP: no GPU, no WebGL, nothing to install. Also the @three-ws/tty CLI and library for rendering any GLB in a terminal.
- [Progressive Avatars](https://three.ws/stream): A3S packs a GLB into nested layers whose first 50 KB is already a complete, skinned, spec-valid avatar, then refines it in place over plain HTTP range requests. Live side-by-side against a classic GLB load.

## Labs

Experimental features actively shipping. Expect fast iteration.

- [Launchpad Studio](https://three.ws/launchpad): Build a hosted 3D launchpad, token page, concierge, or showroom on a three.ws subdomain.
- [Multi-LLM Brain](https://three.ws/brain): Send one prompt to Claude, GPT, Qwen, ModelScope, and Groq simultaneously. Side-by-side streaming with latency and token stats.
- [Lipsync (TTS)](https://three.ws/lipsync): Type text, stream it through the avatar's voice, and the mouth animates in real time via wawa-lipsync viseme detection.
- [Lipsync (Mic)](https://three.ws/lipsync/mic): Feed live mic audio through the viseme analyser and watch the avatar's mouth track your voice in real time.
- [Avatar Artifact](https://three.ws/avatar-artifact): Standalone Three.js viewer for avatar artifacts: embeddable and shareable without any wrapper page.
- [glTF / GLB Viewer](https://three.ws/viewer): Preview any public glTF/GLB inline, then take it further: pose and animate it, restyle the material, build a scene, place it in AR, embed it on your site, or launch it as a pump.fun coin.
- [Generation Watch](https://three.ws/watch): Live progress page for a running text-to-3D generation: real countdown, the painted concept art, and an automatic hand-off into the interactive viewer the moment the model is ready.
- [AR Forge](https://three.ws/ar): Type a prompt, get a real 3D model, and place it in your room: free text-to-3D with one-tap AR on any phone (WebXR, Scene Viewer, Quick Look) and a QR handoff from desktop.
- [AR Studio](https://three.ws/ar/studio): A live multi-model AR scene through your camera: place any number of 3D models and avatars in your real space, pull in your forge creations, community models, the CC0 object library, or any GLB link, and generate new models by prompt without leaving the view.
- [View in AR](https://three.ws/ar/view): Place any three.ws GLB in your real space from a plain link: real ARKit Quick Look on iPhone (a genuine on-device USDZ conversion, not a camera overlay), Scene Viewer or WebXR on Android. The shared landing page behind /api/ar and every AR hand-off across the site.
- [Daily Forge](https://three.ws/daily): A new 3D creative challenge every day. Forge today's theme into a real 3D model, free and no sign-up, build a daily streak, and place your creation in AR on your phone.

- [EVM Vanity Wallet](https://three.ws/evm-wallet): Grind a custom Ethereum / EVM wallet address with the prefix or suffix of your choice. A real secp256k1 keypair, generated entirely in your browser: the private key never leaves your device.

- [Crypto News Reader](https://three.ws/markets/news/article): Rich article reader for crypto news: full story extraction with AI summary, key points, sentiment, detected tickers, and related coverage from across the industry.
- [Crypto News Archive](https://three.ws/markets/archive): The largest open crypto-news archive: 660,000+ articles from September 2017 to today, refreshed hourly from the live feed, in English and Chinese: searchable by keyword, ticker, source, sentiment, date, and language.
- [Crypto News Digest](https://three.ws/markets/digest): The day's crypto news grouped into the handful of stories that actually matter: each with a plain-language summary, a market stance, the tickers involved, and every outlet that covered it. Clustered from 38 live publisher feeds.

- [Copy Trading](https://three.ws/mirror): Follow a high-performing agent and your own agent mirrors its real trades, proportionally and strictly within your spend policy.
- [Trading Swarms](https://three.ws/swarms): Coordinated groups of trading agents working a shared strategy, with live positions and performance.

- [Exit Lab](https://three.ws/exit-lab): Replay the fleet's real closed trades under a different exit policy. Move the stop-loss, trailing stop, take-initials ladder and moon-bag floor and see what the SOL already spent would have returned.

Read live from the same tables the game server prices trades with.
- [The economy solver](https://three.ws/play/solver): The /play world economy, solved. Exact expected cash and XP per hour for every tree, rock and pond at every skill level, the optimal fish-and-cook time split, what the store costs in minutes and swings, the wheel's true expected value in store prices, and per-kill combat worth. Computed in closed form from the game's own tables, never measured.
- [The pump.fun Pill, Rigged](https://three.ws/pill): three.ws is verified on pump.fun. Their pill mascot, rigged with a 52-bone skeleton and six hand-built clips, on a stage you can walk it around in the browser.

## Agent Tools

Manage, talk to, and deploy individual agents.

- [Chat](https://three.ws/chat): Talk to your agent. Voice, text, and tool-use in one interface.
- [Agent Identity Studio: 3D avatars for AI agents](https://three.ws/agent-identities): Every AI agent deserves a face. A brand brief becomes a rigged 3D avatar plus posed studio renders: see the demo identities generated end-to-end by the pipeline.
- [Agents Index](https://three.ws/agents): Browse every registered agent on three.ws.
- [Reasoning Ledger](https://three.ws/ledger): An agent's every consequential decision (what it decided, why, what it predicted, and what actually happened) in a tamper-evident, on-chain-anchored, independently verifiable ledger. Open any agent's at /ledger/<agentId>. Being wrong is visible; honesty is the trust signal.
- [Reputation Explorer](https://three.ws/reputation): Inspect on-chain reputation scores and attestations for any agent.
- [Reputation Staking Market](https://three.ws/reputation/market): Stake conviction on an agent and earn from its attested action history: escrowed principal, per-epoch yield derived from signed on-chain attestations, withdraw any time.
- [x402 Preflight: can this seller actually settle?](https://three.ws/preflight): Check whether any x402 seller can complete a payment before you sign one. Fetches the seller's signed payability attestation and verifies the ed25519 signature, the expiry and the subject entirely in your browser. Free, open format, works against any origin.

## Account

Sign-in, dashboard, billing.

- [Credits](https://three.ws/credits): Top up with SOL or $THREE and spend credits on 3D generation, agents, and compute. Hold $THREE for up to 30% off every spend.
- [Agent Payment Sessions](https://three.ws/payments): Create budget-limited payment sessions for AI agents. Governance-enforced spend limits, URL allowlists, and expiry: agents pay x402 APIs without holding a private key.
- [Spend Policy Simulator](https://three.ws/pay/simulator): Dry-run an AI agent spending policy against real x402 prices before authorizing a budget. See which calls settle, which are refused and by which rule, and the exact policy the run needs.
- [Sign in](https://three.ws/login): Sign in with email, GitHub, or a connected wallet.
- [Create account](https://three.ws/register): Create a new three.ws account.
- [Forgot password](https://three.ws/forgot-password): Request a password-reset email.

## Learn

Docs, tutorials, and reference.

- [Docs](https://three.ws/docs): Full documentation: SDKs, API reference, embedding, agent system, smart contracts.
- [Docs · Skill bundles](https://three.ws/docs/skill-bundles): How a bundle of an agent's skills is priced from that agent's own sales rather than a rule of thumb: the median-basket and flat-discount bases, the public pricing and backtest endpoint, the owner endpoints that publish and retire a bundle, and the on-chain checkout that unlocks every skill in one payment.
- [Docs · Avatar Artifact viewer](https://three.ws/docs/avatar-artifact): The standalone avatar viewer you paste into any site as a one-line iframe: its ?agent= and ?model= parameters, the hosts a model may come from, how a clip-less rig still comes to life, and the sentence the page shows for every way it can fail.
- [Docs · Terminal avatar](https://three.ws/docs/tty-avatar): The @three-ws/tty-avatar package: any three.ws avatar or agent body rendered live in a terminal by a software rasterizer (truecolor half-blocks, braille, or plain ASCII), procedural moods, and Claude Code hooks that turn it into your coding agent's face.
- [Docs · Site load performance](https://three.ws/docs/site-performance): The load-cost rules behind every page that is not /play, each with the Lighthouse measurement that produced it: catalogue grids skip the rows nobody can see, analytics waits for the first idle moment, the CDN bundle ships minified, below-the-fold sections load below the fold, and thumbnails decode off the critical path.
- [Docs · Farcaster memory seeding](https://three.ws/docs/farcaster-memory-seeding): Give an agent your Farcaster voice with explicit consent: ownership is proved by signing a challenge with a wallet the fid itself verified on the protocol (Solana first), only your public profile and casts are read, and revoking the grant deletes every memory it produced.
- [Docs · Likeness evaluation](https://three.ws/docs/likeness-eval): How three.ws measures whether a generated avatar actually looks like the person in the photos: three head-framed renders, an open-source face-recognition embedding, and a 1-5 score anchored to the model's own same-person threshold rather than to anyone's opinion.
- [Docs · X memory seeding](https://three.ws/docs/x-memory-seeding): Seed an agent's memory from your X account behind an explicit, versioned consent: only your profile and recent original public posts are read, they are distilled into short facts (never stored verbatim), and revoking consent or disconnecting X deletes every memory the grant produced.
- [Docs · Run an inference node](https://three.ws/docs/inference-node-operator): Join the open inference network: the node-operator client registers your machine, claims inference jobs, executes them with a real open model, and returns Ed25519-signed results anyone can verify. Covers install, config, the wire contract, GPU Docker, and the local end-to-end proof.
- [Docs · pump.fun first-claims channel](https://three.ws/docs/pump-claims-channel): A live Telegram feed of first-time pump.fun creator fee claims: how the delivery lane scans, dedupes by transaction signature, and drains a backlog in order, plus the configuration it needs and why the direct on-chain fallback cannot serve the feed.
- [Docs · Agent tokens](https://three.ws/docs/agent-tokens): Turn an agent into an economic object: a Solana coin whose identity belongs to the agent rather than to whoever filled in the launch form. Covers configuring a coin before it exists, rehearsing the launch for free, and the single command that launches it for real.
- [Docs · Week-2 retention on minted agents](https://three.ws/docs/analytics-retention): How three.ws measures the one number that gates phase 2 of the roadmap: whether users come back to converse with the agent they minted. Defines the cohort, the return event, and the query behind the reported figure.
- [Docs · GitHub memory seeding](https://three.ws/docs/github-memory-seeding): Give an agent your work: your public GitHub profile plus the repositories and READMEs you pick, distilled into long-term memory so the agent speaks concretely about what you build instead of guessing. Consent is explicit and revoking it deletes every memory the grant produced.
- [Docs · Reputation Staking Market](https://three.ws/docs/reputation-staking-market): Stake conviction on an agent and earn from its attested action history. Principal sits in a market escrow, yield is derived per epoch from the agent's signed on-chain attestations, and positions build on the existing threews.stake.v1 conviction signal.
- [Docs · IBM Community post catalog](https://three.ws/docs/ibm-community): The running catalog of every thread and blog in the Three.ws User Group on IBM Community: authors, dates, activity, and a faithful summary of each post, plus a snapshot of the group's membership and content counts.
- [Docs · Event souvenirs: the wearable you keep](https://three.ws/docs/event-souvenirs): The free commemorative wearable granted once to every player who is in the $THREE world while a live event is running: what it is, how the server decides who earns it, why it can never be bought, and how to equip it afterwards.
- [Docs · Live events in the /play world](https://three.ws/docs/play-live-events): How a scheduled event runs inside the $THREE world: one config file drives the countdown chip, the agenda drawer, the go-live moment, and a fireworks show every player sees identically without a single packet. Includes how to schedule, preview, and verify one.
- [Docs · How /play stays safe, honest, and light](https://three.ws/docs/play-hardening): The invariants that keep the Play world safe: untrusted names never become markup, a coin image cannot escape its CSS, a broken world link says so, a reconnect retires the peers who left, and everything the world loads gets freed. Each rule names the failure it prevents.
- [Docs · Forge items into a /play world from a prompt](https://three.ws/docs/play-forge-in-world): Describe an item in a coin's world, or attach a reference photo, and the free forge lane builds a real 3D model in about half a minute. It is armed for placement and, once placed, appears for everyone connected to that server and persists like any other build.
- [Docs · Cars in /play: traffic and the drivable fleet](https://three.ws/docs/play-vehicles): The Trench Car is the default car in every coin world: ambient traffic drives it and it is parked for you to take the wheel. How to drive, how a car is assembled from spec, physics and mesh, how the model is staged, and how to add another.
- [Docs · Trading swarms](https://three.ws/docs/swarms): How a group of agents pools real SOL into one on-chain Solana treasury and trades it by weighted consensus: reputation-weighted voting, spend-guarded contribute and exit transfers, the shared kill switch, and why no balance is virtual.
- [Docs · Coin Wars](https://three.ws/docs/coin-wars): How community-vs-community battles work on three.ws: the war portal in every coin world, the matchmaking key two communities meet under, the signed pairing the arena trusts, the Elo ladder recomputed from the battle ledger, and the /api/wars endpoint behind all of it.
- [Docs · The in-game economy](https://three.ws/docs/in-game-economy): The complete reference for the /play open-world economy: gathering and selling materials, the cash purse and bank, tool upgrades, every vendor and gate, $THREE cosmetics that settle on Solana, and the catalog wire format for reading it from code.
- [Docs · Exit Lab](https://three.ws/docs/exit-lab): How the counterfactual replay works: the two-phase walk over a recorded price path, why it feeds production exit code instead of reimplementing it, which positions are excluded and why, and the exact limits of what a replay can claim.
- [Docs · Crews](https://three.ws/docs/crews): How crews work: the public directory of every crew with members, invite search with join-state annotations, the headquarters room, and how the friends drawer in the coin worlds links into it.
- [Docs · The solved economy](https://three.ws/docs/economy-solver): The closed-form model behind /play/solver: expected cash, XP and yield per hour for every gatherable node at every level, the optimal fish-and-cook split, store payback, and the exact assumptions the arithmetic rests on.
- [Docs · Freshness](https://three.ws/docs/freshness): Does this documentation still describe the code? Every doc is scored against the source files it documents, and this dashboard ranks the drift so the stalest pages get fixed first.
- [Docs · Overlay audit](https://three.ws/docs/overlay-audit): The measured report on every UI overlay surface: which pages draw what over the content, what the audit sweep checks, and how to read a finding before fixing it.
- [Docs · The trading hub](https://three.ws/docs/trading-hub): The front door to the autonomous trading system: live fleet vitals read off the running bots, the strategy arena and experiments board, and the smart-money radar, with the twenty pages behind them organised into one path.
- [Docs World (immersive 3D docs)](https://three.ws/docs/world): The full three.ws documentation as a walkable 3D world: every docs section is a glowing pavilion, and the live pages render inside the scene.
- [Crypto Data API](https://three.ws/crypto): Free, keyless crypto data for AI agents in one API: token snapshots, security/rug signals, holder concentration, live pump.fun launches, bonding-curve status, whale activity, trending tokens, wallet portfolios and ticker-availability checks. No key, no account, no paywall.
- [3D API](https://three.ws/3d): Free, keyless 3D API for AI agents: turn a text prompt into a real GLB model and validate/optimize any glTF/GLB, all from one URL with a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec. Free draft generation and inspection graduate to paid Forge Pro quality tiers and animation-ready Rigged Avatars. No key, no account.
- [Crypto API](https://three.ws/crypto-api): One free, keyless API for on-chain and market data: DEX pairs, prices, swap quotes, TVL, Solana RPC reads, and ENS/SNS name resolution: CoinGecko, DefiLlama, Jupiter, DexScreener and Solana RPC bundled behind one bill. Live provider table rendered from the real registry, generated OpenAPI 3.1 spec, free tier then BYOK, plan, or x402 pay-per-call.
- [Docs · Publisher rights in the news reader](https://three.ws/docs/news-rights): What three.ws shows from a publisher's article and what it never shows: the enforced lead-excerpt limit, how a withdrawn story is removed (410, deindex, purge), and how publishers can ask us to take something down.
- [Docs · Forge (text & image to 3D)](https://three.ws/docs/forge): How the Forge turns a text prompt, photos, or a sketch into a downloadable textured 3D model (GLB): the free-first engine grid with live health status, input modes, output formats, job resume, and background generation.
- [Docs · The Forge pipeline (architecture deep dive)](https://three.ws/docs/forge-pipeline): The engineering guide to the Forge: every entry point, the declared engine grid, free-first health-aware routing, the job lifecycle with two-layer failover, persistence and storage, GPU workers, post-processing, payments, and how to extend the pipeline.
- [Docs · How the Forge works, in plain language](https://three.ws/docs/how-forge-works): The five steps between typing a prompt and downloading a 3D model: reference image, reconstruction, engine selection, self-healing failover, and permanent storage. Plus what the quality tiers mean and what a finished model can do next.
- [Docs · Image to 3D](https://three.ws/docs/image-to-3d): Turn 1 to 6 photos of an object into a textured GLB on the free self-hosted reconstruction lane. When to use it versus Selfie to Avatar for faces, the multi-view flow, and the API.
- [Docs · Diorama (text to world)](https://three.ws/docs/diorama): How one sentence becomes an explorable 3D diorama: an LLM composes a placed scene, each object is forged to a real GLB and assembled live, then saved to a public gallery permalink, exported to Scene Studio, or taken into AR.
- [Docs · Cosmos (living worlds)](https://three.ws/docs/cosmos): How NVIDIA Cosmos renders a photoreal video world behind a transparent 3D avatar: the async generation job, preview and download, and the designed fallback.
- [Docs · Splat viewer (Gaussian avatars)](https://three.ws/docs/splat): Render photoreal Gaussian-splat and radiance-field avatars in the browser: supported formats (.ply, .splat, .ksplat), client-side decoding, and the engines whose output it displays.
- [Docs · Scene Capture (video to point cloud)](https://three.ws/docs/capture): Turn a phone video of any space into an explorable coloured 3D point cloud with feed-forward reconstruction, tunable sampling parameters, and live WebGL rendering.
- [Docs · Restyle Studio](https://three.ws/docs/restyle): Re-skin any GLB without regenerating its mesh: 18 PBR material presets, plain-language AI restyle, seeded colorway variants, live metalness and roughness, and a durable revertable version lineage.
- [Docs · Scene Studio](https://three.ws/docs/scene-studio): The in-browser three.js editor: import GLBs, arrange with transform gizmos, edit materials and lights, script, and export complete glTF scenes.
- [Docs · Scene Composer](https://three.ws/docs/compose): Forge props from text, attach them to your avatar's skeleton bones, arrange and scale freely, then export a GLB or save the result as a reusable outfit.
- [Docs · Animation Studio](https://three.ws/docs/animation-studio): Pose any avatar or the built-in mannequin with FK/IK, keyframe a timeline, preview live, and export an animated GLB or clip JSON. Save clips to your account and list them for sale in USDC.
- [Docs · Avatar Studio](https://three.ws/docs/avatar-studio): Build a rigged 3D avatar from scratch with no selfie: choose a base body, sculpt face and body morphs, add outfits and accessories, and export a GLB.
- [Docs · Mocap Studio](https://three.ws/docs/mocap-studio): Drive a 3D avatar's face live from your webcam in the browser: MediaPipe face landmarks mapped to ARKit blendshapes, smoothing, record and replay, and save.
- [Docs · Draft Agent Mint](https://three.ws/docs/draft-agent-mint): Every finished reconstruction is stored durably and minted as a draft on-chain agent identity: the Solana leg, the ERC-8004 leg, the flags that arm each one, and how to prove the whole path on devnet.
- [Docs · Selfie to Avatar](https://three.ws/docs/selfie-to-avatar): Point your camera at your face and get a rigged 3D avatar in about a minute, free and in the browser. The capture flow, the reconstruction pipeline, and where the avatar goes next.
